title: Polypharmacy and prescribing in older adults

steps.tx: **Polypharmacy** means use of five or more regular medicines, affecting **forty% of adults** over seventy five years and ninety% of those in nursing homes, with **inappropriate prescribing** in thirty% to fifty% of prescriptions. Adverse drug reactions cause **ten% of admissions** and twenty% of hospital deaths in elders, making prescribing quality a core **geriatric syndrome**.

steps.tx: Risk rises with **age over seventy five years**, female sex, **eight or more medicines**, cognitive impairment, renal disease and **twelve or more prescriptions yearly**. **Anticholinergics**, **benzodiazepines**, **nonsteroidal anti inflammatory** drugs and **beta blockers** top harm lists, while **self medication** with over the counter analgesics adds **bleeding** and **kidney injury** risk sharply.

steps.tx: Ageing alters **pharmacokinetics** and **pharmacodynamics**. A flow traces reduced clearance, higher sensitivity and **drug interactions** to adverse effects, showing why **creatinine clearance below thirty** demands dose cuts and **serum levels** guard a drug for long term illness and **a heart drug** toxicity. This vulnerability explains **dose sensitive toxicity** at standard adult doses and longer half lives in muscle wasting elders with **low body weight** and hypoalbuminaemia.

steps.tx: Classic adverse signs mimic geriatric disease: **falls**, acute **confusion**, **constipation**, **urinary retention**, **hyponatraemia** and **hypotension** within two weeks of a new drug. **Anticholinergic burden score over three**, **Beers criteria** flags and postural **systolic drop over twenty mmHg** each point to prescribing harm before disease progression is blamed.

steps.tx: Beers and STOPP tools are compared. This contrast separates American **Beers two thousand twenty three** drug lists from European **STOPP criteria** on renal and **sedative burden**, because trainees must name the tool, not just the drug, in prescription audit questions. Examiners expect candidates to quote **STOPP version three** pairs for renal dosing and sedation, plus **Beers two thousand twenty three** thresholds for falls and confusion risk after review.

steps.tx: Review starts with **medication reconciliation** within twenty four hours, then **renal function**, **eGFR**, **a salt balance treatment**, **ECG** and **serum drug levels** for a mood stabilising drug and a heart drug. **Gold standard** is structured STOPP START audit plus **pharmacist review** at discharge, while **anticholinergic burden scale** quantifies cumulative **sedative load** better than drug count alone.
steps.say: Review starts with medication reconciliation within twenty four hours, then kidney function, a salt balance treatment, ECG and blood drug levels for a mood stabilising drug and a heart drug. steps.tx: First line is to **deprescribe** one drug at a time with **twenty five% taper** over four weeks, correct **renal dosing** by creatinine clearance and keep **a pain relief tablet maximum two g daily** over age sixty five. Stop **proton pump inhibitors** beyond eight weeks without indication, switch **a mood stabilising drug three hundred mg** with hydration checks and control **potassium four point zero mmol per litre** targets.
steps.say: First line is to stop one drug at a time with twenty five percent taper over four weeks, correct kidney dosing by creatinine clearance and keep a pain relief tablet maximum two grams daily over age sixty five. steps.tx: Specific swaps include **a cholesterol tablet ten mg** review in primary prevention over eighty five years, **a blood pressure tablet two point five mg** start low for hypertension, **a diabetes tablet five hundred mg** only above eGFR thirty, and **a sleep aid three mg** instead of a sleep tablet for sleep. **Deprescribing clinics**, **dose optimisation** and **blister packs** improve **adherence over eighty%** in supervised elders.

steps.tx: Complications after poor prescribing include **hospital acquired delirium**, **hip fracture**, **gastrointestinal bleed** in one in fifty a pain relief drug users yearly, and **hyperkalaemia** with an antibiotic tablet. Prognosis improves when **drug count falls below five**, since **ninety day mortality** drops by fifteen% and **readmission** falls by twenty% after structured **medication review** programs.

steps.tx: **High-yield for the exam**: polypharmacy is **five drugs**, taper at **twenty five%**, credit **Beers** and **STOPP**, never blame disease before checking **new drug timing**.
